'''BR-0''' was an [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]].<ref name="LotS" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
BR-0 was first introduced in the [[August]] [[2026]] update of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith]]'',<ref name="Droid">{{TORweb|url=info/news/%5Bnews-category%5D/20260827|text=Celebrate the launch of Star Wars Zero Company™ with a free mini-pet!}}</ref> the eighth digital expansion to the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Announcement">{{TORweb|url=info/news/article/20210701|text=Announcing Legacy of the Sith, the next expansion for Star Wars: The Old Republic}}</ref> The astromech droid, inspired by [[BR-1]], was introduced as a mini-pet in celebration of the launch of ''[[Star Wars Zero Company]]'', and was gifted to players who logged in between [[August 27]] and [[September 17]] of 2026.<ref name="Droid" />
